Furthermore, a two-electrode electrolyzer employing 20 wt% Pt/C supported carbon cloth as the cathode and PSCFM supported carbon cloth as the anode demonstrates stable electrolysis at 10 mA cm −2 for ~50 h (Fig. 3h).

The Faraday efficiency of PSCFM and PSCF anode catalysts was determined by measuring the concentration of gaseous products using gas chromatography based on an efficient four-electron reaction process.
